title: Simultaneous exact finite-dimensional and approximate all-direction shape desensitization of the heat equation for disjoint control and observation sets with connected observation complement
source_title: Desensitizing control for the heat equation with respect to domain variations
author: Sylvain Ervedoza; Pierre Lissy; Yannick Privat
difficulty_reason: Dense linear Neumann traces alone cannot solve the quadratic shape-response constraints while keeping all remaining directions small. Section2 constructs paired time-separated trace targets so that the finite-dimensional quadratic response can be controlled, then closes the exact constraints through a Brouwer correction. The final approximate-control stage must preserve that nonlinear correction uniformly, which remains a substantive construction after standard heat and fixed-point foundations are allowed.

proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. Exact Theorem1.7 on bounded connected C2 domain Omega0, nonempty disjoint open omega/Theta, Theta compactly contained in Omega0 and Omega0 minus closureTheta connected, T>0, arbitrary L2 source xi, epsilon>0 and finite-dimensional E in W3,infinity(Rd;Rd). A single L2 interior control exactly kills first shape derivatives along E and uniformly epsilon-bounds them for all admissible vector fields; no terminal null control or exact infinite-dimensional desensitization promised. Full new boundary-dense adjoint proof13–15 and paired-target/Brouwer/small-source construction16–23 read. Native source checked geometric complement closure. Shape derivative Proposition1.1, Holmgren continuation, parabolic maximal regularity/transposition trace, Sobolev trace surjectivity and Brouwer theorem are explicitly existing foundations. Near-boundary trace recovery in adjoint proof uses its already established open collar vanishing; this named transposition foundation is not a new core construction. Typographical q/z and gamma_z/gamma_y labels are fixed by adjacent explicit target pairs; terminal L-infinity(V dot n) estimate is the one used for W3,infinity(V) bound, no extra regularity of the C1 normal asserted. No intersecting-control variant, elementary approximate-only consequence or exact-desensitization counterexample separately counted.
